guideTitle: Best Compact Washer and Dryer Sets (2026)
metaTitle: Best Compact Washer and Dryer Sets (2026)
metaDescription: Six compact washer and dryer sets, from portable pairs to a 24 inch laundry center, compared on drum size, dryer venting, power needs and real small-space fit.
expertTake: The Equator ultra compact stackable set is the best buy for most small homes because its washer and 2.6 cu ft vented dryer match in width and share a 110V supply. The ROVSUN 25 lb plus 3.5 cu ft portable set is the value choice for anyone who needs real capacity without a hardwired install. Renters who cannot vent a dryer should look at one all-in-one combo instead of a set.
introParagraphs: A washer and dryer set is two machines sold together because their sizes, controls and cabinet widths are designed to match. In a small home that matters more than it does in a full laundry room, since a set can stack, share a power cord or tuck into the same closet without custom shelving.

Sets in this class fall into three camps: portable pairs you roll out of a closet, narrow stackable pairs with a real vent, and a unitized laundry center that puts both machines in one tower. The differences that matter are how the dryer gets rid of moisture, what power it draws and how much the dryer can handle compared with the washer.

products.name: Equator ultra compact stackable washer and dryer set 110V

specList.label: Dryer cycles
specList.value: Sensor Dry, Air Dry, Warm, Hot, Timed

products.description:
This is the only set here built around a real vented dryer on a 110V supply, which means it plugs into an ordinary outlet and still dries with exhaust air rather than a condenser. The 2.6 cu ft dryer offers Sensor Dry plus Air Dry, Warm, Hot and Timed Dry, so it can stop when clothes are dry instead of running a timer to the end. The 1.57 cu ft washer adds 15 programs including Sanitize, Allergen, PET and Baby.

The tradeoff is that vented drying needs a vent path, either a duct to the outside or a window kit, so a renter without one should look elsewhere. Against the ROVSUN set it asks for more installation effort but removes the manual spin step.

Plan the install around the exhaust route and the stacking hardware. Clean the lint screen after every load, check the vent hose for sagging bends and level the washer before you stack anything on top.

cons: Vented drying needs an exhaust path

products.name: GE Unitized Spacemaker 2.3 cu ft washer and 4.4 cu ft electric dryer
products.description:
GE's Spacemaker is a unitized laundry center: a top-load washer sits under a front-opening dryer inside one 24 inch cabinet, so there is nothing to stack and nothing that can shift. The washer is 2.3 cu ft and the dryer 4.4 cu ft, a ratio that favors drying and means a full washer load fits in the dryer in one go, unlike the combos.

It is also the most permanent choice. The electric dryer typically wants a dedicated dryer circuit and a vent, so check the electrical and exhaust requirements before you order, and know that moving it later is a two-person job. Against the Equator set it offers a larger dryer but a single cabinet you cannot rearrange.

For ownership, the single cabinet means one footprint, one set of leveling feet and one vent run. Clean the lint trap after each load and have the vent inspected yearly, since lint buildup in a long duct is a real fire risk.
products.bestFor: Closet installs where stacking hardware is a worry and dryer capacity matters.
pros: Single unitized cabinet needs no stacking kit
4.4 cu ft dryer handles a full washer load
24 inch width fits tight closets
Auto dry and timed dry controls
cons: Needs a vent and a suitable electrical supply

products.name: ROVSUN 25 lb fully automatic washer with 3.5 cu ft portable dryer
products.description:
ROVSUN pairs a 25 lb fully automatic washer with a 3.5 cu ft portable electric dryer rated for up to 13.2 lb. The washer offers ten modes and five water levels, and the dryer is the bigger of the portable dryers in this guide, with a drum that is nearly double the 1.8 cu ft units from other makers.

The drying side is the limit. A 13.2 lb dry load is about half of what the washer can handle, so a full wash needs two drying cycles, and a portable electric dryer needs a hose or a window for moisture, a detail the listing does not cover. Compared with the DOGHLY it holds noticeably more and costs more.

For ownership, this pair stores in a closet and rolls out on laundry day. Clean the lint filter every load, confirm the exhaust method before the first cycle and run the washer's drum dry between uses to keep odors away.
products.bestFor: Renters who want a large portable pair without any permanent install.
pros: 3.5 cu ft dryer is the largest portable dryer here
Washer has ten modes and five water levels
Both machines are portable
Total price tier is modest for a pair
cons: Dry load is about half the wash capacity
Exhaust method for the dryer is not detailed
Portable dryers take longer than vented models

products.name: Auertech 28 lb washer with 2.8 cu ft portable dryer and boot dryer
products.description:
Auertech's set offers a 28 lb fully automatic washer with ten cycles, including a 26 minute quick wash, and a built-in drain pump that can send water to a sink from a distance. The 2.8 cu ft portable dryer adds a boot dryer function, an odd extra that suits hikers and anyone who stands in wet shoes.

It is a middle path between the smaller DOGHLY set and the bigger ROVSUN one. The washer capacity is generous, but the dryer is smaller than the ROVSUN's, so a full wash still needs two drying runs.

Ownership centers on the drain pump and the dryer lint trap. Clean the pump filter regularly, keep the drain hose secured and check how the dryer's exhaust is handled before use, since the listing does not cover it.
products.bestFor: Households that need a large washer and a boot-drying extra.
pros: 28 lb washer with a built-in drain pump
10 cycles including a 26 minute quick wash
Boot dryer function included
Portable pair needs no install
cons: Dryer is smaller than the washer can fill

products.name: DOGHLY 17 lb washer with 1.8 cu ft clothes dryer set
products.description:
DOGHLY's pair is the smallest set here: a 17 lb fully automatic washer with a 26 minute quick wash and a 1.8 cu ft electric dryer with multi-speed drying rated for up to 10 lb. The listing frames it as a same-day wash and dry setup for people without access to a laundry room.

That modest scale is the appeal and the limit. The dryer drum is small, so towels and bedding go in pieces, and the pair is for one or two people. Compared with the ROVSUN set it is lighter and cheaper but holds a little more than half as much.

For ownership, treat the dryer's lint screen as a per-load chore and keep the machines on a hard, level floor. Confirm how moisture leaves the dryer before the first run, since portable dryers either vent or condense and the listing is not specific.
products.bestFor: Singles and couples who want the cheapest matched pair.
pros: Lowest total footprint of the sets
26 minute quick wash on the washer
Multi-speed drying mode
Light enough to roll away
cons: 10 lb dryer limit means bedding goes in pieces

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 2.7 cu ft washer and dryer combo BCW27MW

specList.label: Cycles
specList.value: 16 including My Cycle and Quick Wash

products.description:
This one is not a pair but a combo, included because many people searching for a set really need a single drum. It washes and dries in one 2.7 cu ft front-load cabinet, with 16 cycles and a ventless 120V dryer offering Auto Dry and Timed Dry, so no exhaust duct is required.

A combo trades speed and capacity for simplicity. Drying a full load takes far longer than in a vented dryer, and the dry capacity is lower than the wash capacity. Against the Equator set it needs no venting but takes a lot more time per load.

For ownership, leave the door ajar to dry the drum, wipe the gasket, and run a clean cycle monthly. Plan on drying half loads, because overfilling the drum is the most common reason combos leave clothes damp.
products.bestFor: Apartments with no vent route that need one machine only.
pros: Washes and dries in one drum
Ventless 120V operation needs no duct
16 cycles with My Cycle and Quick Wash
One footprint instead of two
cons: Slow drying and smaller dry loads

buyingCriteria.explanation: A dryer either vents warm wet air outside, as the Equator and GE do, or condenses it into water, as ventless combos like the BLACK+DECKER do. Portable dryers in the ROVSUN, Auertech and DOGHLY sets often use a hose or a window kit, but their listings rarely say which. Venting dries fastest, and the choice should follow what your building allows.

A set only works as a system if the dryer can take what the washer produces. The GE's 4.4 cu ft dryer swallows a 2.3 cu ft wash easily, while the DOGHLY's 10 lb dryer is a little over half of its 17 lb washer's rating. If the dryer is much smaller, you will run two dry cycles for one wash.

The Equator set runs on 110V and the BLACK+DECKER on 120V, which fit ordinary outlets. A full-size electric dryer like the GE's unit usually needs a dedicated dryer circuit. Heated drying draws heavy current, so do not share the circuit with a space heater or a microwave.

Stackable sets need the matching kit and a stiff floor, and the stack must be secure against vibration. A unitized tower such as the GE removes that risk but locks you into one arrangement. Portable pairs avoid it entirely by sitting side by side.

Sensor dry on the Equator stops when clothes are dry, saving energy over a fixed timer. Quick-wash modes of 26 minutes on the Auertech and DOGHLY are useful for small loads. A cycle list matters less than whether the machine can stop itself at the right moment.

A vented set needs a duct and a drain, while a portable pair needs only a faucet and a place for the dryer's moisture to go. Renters should weigh how easily each can leave when the lease ends. A portable pair rolls out, while a unitized tower stays until a team moves it.

howWeEvaluated.title: Dryer capability
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at drum size, venting method and sensing. The GE's 4.4 cu ft and the Equator's vented sensor dryer led. Portable dryers without an exhaust explanation scored lower.

howWeEvaluated.title: Washer-to-dryer match
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared wash and dry capacity. The GE's ratio is favorable, while the ROVSUN and Auertech pair a large washer with a smaller dryer.

howWeEvaluated.title: Electrical fit
howWeEvaluated.description: We checked voltage and circuit needs. The Equator's 110V and the BLACK+DECKER's 120V fit ordinary outlets. Full-size electric dryers scored lower for renters.

howWeEvaluated.title: Install flexibility
howWeEvaluated.description: We assessed stacking, hosing and portability. Portable pairs are easiest to move. The GE is the most permanent.

howWeEvaluated.title: Everyday features
howWeEvaluated.description: We gave credit for cycles that save time, like sensor dry and 26 minute washes, and ignored padding such as long cycle lists.

cards.label: Set of two machines
cards.text: The Equator, GE, ROVSUN, Auertech and DOGHLY pairs let you dry one load while washing the next. They are faster in total time and dry larger loads.

cards.label: Single combo
cards.text: The BLACK+DECKER washes and dries in one drum with no duct. It is slower, but it fits where a second machine cannot.

howToChoose.note: Choose a set if you have the space and power, a combo if you do not.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A machine that runs on a normal outlet, needs no permanent install and leaves with you. Check lease rules about venting and plumbing.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The ROVSUN, Auertech and DOGHLY pairs are portable. The BLACK+DECKER needs no duct, and the Equator needs a window kit or duct.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You do laundry weekly and want faster drying. The Equator's vented sensor dryer and the GE's 4.4 cu ft drum save hours.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You wash small loads. The DOGHLY or Auertech set covers the basics.

maintenance.why: Lint blocks airflow, lengthens drying and is a fire hazard. A clean screen is the best safety habit.

maintenance.task: Inspect the vent hose or duct
maintenance.why: A sagging or crushed hose traps lint and moisture. Straight, short runs dry faster and are safer.
Lint and small objects stop the pump. A clean filter prevents error codes.

maintenance.task: Wipe door seals and leave doors ajar
maintenance.why: Moisture in a closed drum breeds mildew. Open doors let it dry out.
Vibration loosens fittings. A secure, level stack runs quieter and avoids tipping.

faq.q: Is a washer and dryer set better than a combo?
faq.a: A set dries faster and handles bigger loads because you wash one while drying another. A combo saves space and needs no duct. Choose by your space, power and how many loads you do each week.

faq.q: How much do compact sets cost?
faq.a: Listing prices drift, but the DOGHLY is at the low end and the Equator and GE sets at the high end. Budget for a vent kit, stacking hardware and any electrical work. A cheaper portable pair may need replacing sooner.
They work for small loads but dry slower than full-size vented dryers and hold less. Confirm how they exhaust moisture. They suit one or two people.

faq.q: Can I stack any washer and dryer?
faq.a: No. You need matching widths and a stacking kit designed for the models. The Equator and GE are built for this, while portable pairs sit side by side.

faq.q: Does a ventless dryer take longer?
faq.a: Yes, often noticeably. Condenser drying removes moisture more slowly than venting. Plan on half loads and extra time.
Many compact units run on 110V or 120V, but a full-size electric dryer such as the GE's usually needs a dedicated circuit. Check the manual before ordering and avoid sharing the circuit.
